messages.text:
BL-1618 — Every role runs every test lane on every parcel - six full unit runs, six 320 s property runs, six acceptance runs and a Stryker pass per ticket at cap 5-6 on one host - and no prompt says which lanes are whose; the human on 2026-09-17: the swarm knowingly runs tests for hours and it is becoming a thing in itself; one script holds the lane table per role, prints the plan, runs exactly it sequentially and refuses an unknown role, so the property lane runs at most twice per parcel and the intermediate roles run the mapped set, the unit lane only when they touched extension/, and the ticket's own acceptance feature
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: Your 2026-09-17 ask ("each role has to be more careful about each tests to run"), turned into a mechanism: one script, one lane table, one plan per role. FIRM: QA still runs every lane once per parcel - the final gate is unchanged. FIRM: cleaner, architect and documenter never run the property lane…
BL-1618 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1618" (or "reject BL-1618 <reason>") to act.
